train_disambiguation_model: train a GPT-2 or BERT disambiguation model on SIMMC2 dialogue data with configurable backbone and hyperparameters
evaluate_model: evaluate a trained disambiguation model and compute accuracy on validation or test datasets
save_model_predictions: save model predictions to JSON files organized by dialog_id and turn_id for devtest and teststd splits
configure_tokenizer: configure a GPT-2 or BERT tokenizer with custom special tokens <USER> and <SYS> for dialogue disambiguation
run_training_loop: run a training loop with exponential moving average loss tracking and periodic evaluation on dev/devtest/teststd splits
